text: This report recommends that City Council state its intention to designate the properties at 21, 23, 25, 27, 29, 31, 33, 35, and 37 Kensington Avenue under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act for their cultural heritage value according to the Statements of Significance which include descriptions of Heritage Attributes found in Attachments 1, 2, and 3. The subject properties occupy nine adjacent lots on the east side of Kensington Avenue, mid-block between St. Andrew Street to the north and Dundas Street West to the south. The properties are located on one of the key mixed-use commercial streets within the broader Kensington Market neighbourhood, an area recognized by locals and visitors alike as a dynamic destination for retail, restaurants, and international products all supported by an active and creative community base.
